page_note: Heavily damaged page (93.5%) but content is dominantly substrate cosmology: enumeration of dwellings (third, seventh), the twelve hours, twelve doctrines (=zodiac signs of Matter), twelve spirits of the Ancient One (ⲡⲣⲙⲛⲉⲥ), the desire of death, the world of flesh begotten from the second dwelling. Only segment 23 ('judges them today') has a clear temporal anchor toward editorial present.
